div.p: Artist unknown Marble bust Date unknown Location: Conservator

Little is known of the history of this marble bust of 13th-century Italian poet Dante Alighieri. It came into the possession of the City of Melbourne as a gift from the Dante Alighieri Society to commemorate the 1956 Melbourne Olympic Games.
